evidence_rows.inference: Organ-specific assay evidence; one normal hepatic enzyme assessment does not establish normal hepatobiliary transport, reserve, other mitochondrial functions or drug tolerance.
Retain the existing separate muscle/liver function question without adding an unvalidated universal mitochondrial gate.

evidence_rows.observation: Abnormal bile transport/canalicular organization with partial improvement after hepatocyte Mtm1 reexpression or dynamin-directed compounds.
evidence_rows.inference: Supports disease-related hepatic biology; the identified interventions do not supply a BLU or C2beta exposure-response bridge.

evidence_rows.model: Mtm1-deficient, diet-sensitized mice and liver-specific Mtm1 loss

evidence_rows.inference: AAV8 findings cannot be assigned to BLU. No new model-access, cost, exposure threshold or ready human assay is established.

evidence_rows.observation: Adult XLMTM/ADCNM baseline liver findings and a DNM2 antisense program with tolerability limitations remain distinct from C2beta inhibition.
evidence_rows.inference: Adult survival or eligibility for another trial does not establish BLU hepatic safety or a quantified liver-ineligible commercial niche.

evidence_rows.perturbation: Lifelong protein-retaining C2beta-D1212A catalytic inactivation in otherwise healthy mice
evidence_rows.observation: Previously reviewed metabolic and tissue-histology reassurance.
evidence_rows.inference: Healthy genetic reassurance cannot substitute for interpretable systemic exposure and disease-relevant hepatic function.

evidence_rows.subject: Current VALOR population and study aim
evidence_rows.observation: Sponsor continues to describe a first-in-human open-label phase 1/2 safety/tolerability/dose-finding program in invasively ventilated males projected to be at most 36 months at dosing.
evidence_rows.primary_claim: Dose and tolerability qualification; no interpretable efficacy result recovered here.
evidence_rows.inference: Trial eligibility describes the tested subset; it is not an eventual indication label, number of commercially reachable patients, or evidence that BLU is adequate in excluded patients.

evidence_rows.subject: Exact next-generation program description
evidence_rows.observation: Sponsor identifies ASP2957 as human MTM1 delivery using MyoAAV3.8 and reports greater muscle specificity/reduced liver targeting in nonclinical work.
evidence_rows.inference: The active competitor is specifically attempting to improve the organ-distribution problem. Do not assume AT132 failure fixes a permanent liver-ineligible niche for BLU.

evidence_rows.subject: Relative dose claim
evidence_rows.observation: Sponsor describes starting the clinical study at about 100-fold lower dose than AT132.
evidence_rows.inference: This is a starting-dose/program claim. It does not demonstrate a 100-fold therapeutic index, equal efficacy, a final recommended dose, or a numerical reduction in patient risk. Do not back-calculate an ASP2957 dose from one historical AT132 cohort.

evidence_rows.subject: Long-term follow-up plan
evidence_rows.observation: An official-domain indexed sponsor listing identifies NCT07876804 / 2957-CL-4001 as long-term follow-up for males treated with ASP2957, with status Will Be Recruiting.
evidence_rows.inference: This shows a stated follow-up plan. It does not demonstrate durability, an additional treated cohort or observed outcomes. Listing details should remain bounded to the indexed source.

evidence_rows.subject: Retained human benchmark
evidence_rows.observation: ASPIRO supplies human ventilatory and motor-function evidence for AT132, together with four treated deaths with cholestatic liver failure; the modified analyses are exploratory/as treated.
evidence_rows.inference: Keep this predecessor product distinct from ASP2957 and BLU. A dish-force result cannot be converted into hours off ventilation, and AT132 harms cannot be assigned to BLU or ASP2957.

evidence_rows.subject: Bounded comparator challenge result
evidence_rows.observation: This finite pass did not recover an ASP2957 clinical efficacy estimate, dose-defined human safety improvement, a broad eligible population or a directly comparative BLU result.
evidence_rows.inference: Retain the selected bounded information sprint. Favorable future competitor data can change the useful product contribution; the present program plans cannot settle that comparison.

evidence_rows.subject: Initial qualification envelope
evidence_rows.inference: Initial qualification can end before an interpretable human functional answer; this envelope is not a complete proof budget.

evidence_rows.subject: Conditional functional increment
evidence_rows.inference: Keep the additional scope visible when comparing cost to the actual decision-changing endpoint. No automatic release, guaranteed sequential schedule or full-program total is asserted.

evidence_rows.subject: Information priority versus development rank
evidence_rows.inference: Being next eligible for source work does not make BLU the best actual development investment; compare the specific next commitment after its inputs are known.

evidence_rows.subject: Product contribution and capture
candidate_population_or_use: Specified older or less severely ventilated patients if benefit and tolerability are established
Useful repeatable control or a defined complementary role if meaningful incremental value is shown
evidence_rows.inference: Do not monetize the entire XLMTM population, assume all gene-therapy exclusions are addressable by BLU, infer oral dosing is cheaper or safer, or count assay/data-generation value as an exclusive asset.

evidence_rows.subject: Reversal and waiting option
evidence_rows.inference: If a reproducible existing formulation/model route becomes a major chemistry, model-construction, systemic-safety or rights program before an informative result, stop extending the illustrative small tranche and rerank its actual cost, time, learning and retained value against eligible alternatives and waiting. Missing public price is not evidence of biological failure.
